author: Z.Dubbs
title: You win when they want you to win
content:
Let me begin by saying I agree with everyone that the cash is legit. You can earn money if you deposit money… possibly.

However, the reason for 2 stars is because of the “possibly.” Sure the game is luck, and the game itself is perhaps a bit of skill, but ultimately, you never win money based on your performance or luck in each round. Instead, the luck comes from what players the algorithm matches you with. I have played games where I have had multiple errors and player pretty poorly where I get matched up with similar scoring players, and sometimes win those matches. Other times, I play my absolute best, with zero flaws, filling up the entire board and using double points, and the entire ranking pool is within 100s of my score (in the 50,000 range), and I’ll get second or third.

Ultimately, it entirely comes down to the algorithm matching you. No matter how amazing and lucky you get at this game in each of your bingo rounds, your winnings are pure luck of the draw and not dependent on your game outcome at all

author: ninkaw
title: The only $$ winners are developers
content:
Without any doubt the only winners are the developers. I say this as a seasoned player. The rake is absurdly high; the game takes about 27-32% out of every single pot (depending on the game you choose). That alone is enough to make it near impossible to win longterm.

But there is also a random (luck) element within the gameplay that guarantees wins and losses are spread amongst players over time. Blue-colored bonuses allow you to pick a free bingo number, however, this selected number can still be part of the draw later in the game. If your opponent(s) picked a “better” number (i.e. one that is not repeated in the draw), they will then also get the “bad” bonus number you picked from the draw and have a distinct advantage to outscore you, or vice versa. It may seem like a small thing, but in reality this ensures that everyone gets their share of bad luck. The desired result for the devs, of course, is to make everyone have to deposit more money to keep playing.

Lastly, it appears that the level of your competition gets harder after you go on a good run. Although not provable it seems to be the case. There is no oversight or regulation to prevent the devs from doing this and other players’ reviews have mentioned it as well.

Bottom line: fun game, play it for free stars. Do NOT play with your own money unless you are willing to lose it, because the game is designed for you to do just that.
